rv.q: By that criterion, Bodies is an outstanding success, before one even begins to admire a marvellous cast, under the careful eye of director Jude Christian.
Dominated and ultimately hindered by its unfortunate subtext, Bodies leaves its audience feeling uneasy for all the wrong reasons.

cn.t: Franzmann's exploration of surrogacy ethics earns praise for intelligent debate and strong performances, though critics split on its execution—some laud its challenging power while others find it lacks emotional intensity and suffers from problematic subtext.
